description: Read a completed output in base64 chunks (up to 1 MiB). Follow next_offset until null. Binary files remain private.

offset.description: Byte offset for the next result chunk, starting at zero.

service.description: Studio that owns the source, or whose details or requests you want to read.

variant.description: Named output variant to read; available variants depend on the studio and request.
